Author: Mayo Botic
Name: PF Presets
Description: Save and manage Party Finder recruitment presets. Configure duty, objective, roles, conditions, and more - then apply any preset with a single click to instantly set up your Party Finder listing.
Punchline: One-click Party Finder presets. Save your recruitment settings and reuse them instantly.
Changelog: Auto Refresher now performs the full Edit -> Apply Changes sequence, so it reliably re-posts your listing. Added a live countdown timer next to the toggle, a choice of 15 or 30 minute intervals, and a /pfp refresh command to refresh on demand.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: DutyDM
Description: Get a Discord DM the instant your duty pops. Join the DutyDM Discord server, enter your Discord username, and the bot will message you the moment your queue is ready - with an in-game popup confirming it sent.
Punchline: Duty-pop alerts straight to your Discord DMs.
Changelog: Party-full alerts now only fire when the last seat fills while you wait (7 -> 8), and are blocked for 30 seconds after leaving a duty. Joining an already-full PF or re-forming after an instance no longer sends a redundant notification.
